former_chapter_findings: Rounded cut purity 0.891 was labelled as an AUC although the producer reports no cut AUC.
Logistic-regression truth-MC output was described as a data weak-label leave-one-run-out result.
HGB point estimates were promoted as a truth ceiling and irreducible detector limit.
Sample-I/Sample-II stopping-depth tables and a combined decision-tree operating point were not in the tracked MV1 summary.
A plus/minus 4 percent PID systematic budget was asserted without a tracked propagation model.
The source uses row-index parity and does not retain event IDs, so event-group leakage cannot be excluded.
MV2 mean_ekin_MeV values are about 1e-4 MeV; the momentum-unit conversion is not bound and range-energy interpretation is blocked.
scientific_boundary: Documentation and source-contract validation only. No ROOT rerun, beam-data PID measurement, uncertainty interval, stopping-depth closure, production classifier, calibration, or detector-performance claim.
